mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Log-space offset is cheap, not free; report instructions/bandwidth/passes.

mechanisms.name: Perfect alias elimination
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: PDM/dither redistributes error; quality is finite and measurable.

mechanisms.name: Universal O(1)
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Only fixed closed-expression state queries may be horizon-independent; event/branch costs remain.

mechanisms.name: Zero memory/latency/heat
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: All state, caches, logs, sources, actuators and controls count.

mechanisms.name: Perfect determinism/exact chaos
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Finite precision, degeneracies and external novelty require uncertainty and logs.

mechanisms.name: One bit as complete state
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: One bit is route/validity only; continuous state and lineage remain separate.

mechanisms.name: No broad phase ever
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Support/compatibility are themselves analytic broad-phase/pruning operators.

mechanisms.name: General AI/world replacement
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: No support in corpus; restrict to state/event substrate.

mechanisms.name: Biological one-bit equivalence
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Use as analogy only; biological/quantum mechanisms are not established by the geometry.

mechanisms.name: Physical-GPU benchmark boundary
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Results prove API-native execution and correctness on named device, not physical-GPU throughput.

mechanisms.name: Native device-clock L2 boundary
mechanisms.source_motif: 512-step dependent chase across the reported 36 MiB L2
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: A saturated random dependent-load working set is flat through 36 MiB, then rises at 38 MiB and sharply at 40 MiB.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: VK_KHR_shader_clock control plus dependent SSBO chase.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through its Vulkan driver.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured with implementation-defined clock-unit and scheduler-exposure bounds

mechanisms.name: Native CUDA L2 cycle control
mechanisms.source_motif: One-warp ld.global.cg hot and post-eviction dependent chains
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: The immediate-hot L2/global path is about 400 exposed cycles per dependent warp step while a 256 MiB eviction raises it to about 1088 cycles on the named GPU.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 clock64 control and dependent ld.global.cg loop.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured with time-slicing and multi-sector warp-step bounds

mechanisms.name: Native CUDA L2 concurrency curve
mechanisms.source_motif: One-warp blocks scaled through the 24-warps-per-SM occupancy ceiling around the 36 MiB boundary
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: At 1104 warps hot requested throughput is unchanged between 4 and 36 MiB but falls 45.20% at 40 MiB and 82.59% at 128 MiB.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 clock64 plus CUDA-event dependent-chain matrix.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured logical requested-load throughput with scheduling and transaction-granularity bounds

mechanisms.name: Native CUDA texture-path capacity control
mechanisms.source_motif: Byte-identical dependent chains through linear texture object and L1-bypassing global loads
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Native TLD and LDG paths share the same 36-40 MiB throughput cliff; texture adds no effective capacity tier and is slower at low concurrency.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 TLD.LZ versus LDG.E.STRONG.GPU matched matrix.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured with logical-throughput and unavailable-counter bounds

mechanisms.name: Dense 6-bit CUDA log-LUT packing
mechanisms.source_motif: Sixteen 6-bit codes per three words versus two 16-bit slots per word
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Dense packing realizes 2.667x code capacity at the same bytes; on the named GPU the saturated texture path preserves 98.61% of slot16 throughput at the 36 MiB capacity endpoint.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 packed extraction through matched TLD.LZ and LDG.E.STRONG.GPU paths.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured logical decoded-code throughput with per-load validation and unavailable-counter bounds

mechanisms.name: Native CUDA sparse-stride effective residency
mechanisms.source_motif: One consumed dependent pointer u32 at 4-256 byte spacing with mixed filler
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Active-node capacity scales 4:2:1 at 32/64/128-byte spacing and saturates by 128 bytes, bounding dependent-pointer effective residency at 128 bytes for the named workload.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 nonlinear dependent ld.global.cg chase with CPU replay and spacing controls.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured workload-level effective residency with dependency, physical-line and unavailable-counter bounds

mechanisms.name: Packed-LUT neighborhood occupancy curve
mechanisms.source_basis: Package physical-GPU CUDA LUT line-occupancy runs
mechanisms.source_motif: One to 170 useful packed6 codes per aligned 128-byte region with mixed filler and exact 32-byte boundary probes
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: At 36 MiB all layouts sustain 42.437-43.010 Glookup/s while post-L2 throughput changes continuously with address-region touch probability, rejecting a universal 128-byte cost for independently scheduled packed codes.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 independent packed6 lookup matrix through matched TLD.LZ and LDG.E.STRONG.GPU paths.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured logical decoded-code throughput with arithmetic address-span and unavailable-counter bounds

mechanisms.name: Sparse-LUT residency decomposition
mechanisms.source_basis: Package physical-GPU CUDA sparse-address and one-code refinement runs
mechanisms.source_motif: One packed6 code per 32-256 byte region with matched requested-data line-count and address-span controls
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Independent sparse packed-LUT throughput cannot be predicted by requested data bytes, allocation, or containing-line count alone; resident data portions, containing-line-address pressure, and address span are separately observable timing terms.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 independent packed6 global/texture stride matrix with exact line-equivalent refinement.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured timing model with undocumented-sector tag set TLB and unavailable-counter bounds

mechanisms.name: Sparse-LUT page-spaced address reach
mechanisms.source_basis: Package physical-GPU CUDA page-span and page-stride runs
mechanisms.source_motif: One checked packed6 word per 128-byte through 4-KiB address stride
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: At fixed useful words and containing test-line count, full-rate independent sparse lookup persists through a 252 MiB address span and transitions between 252 and 256 MiB on the named workload.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 matched LDG/TLD page-stride matrix through a 1-GiB allocation span.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured logical throughput with page-size TLB set partition and unavailable-counter bounds

mechanisms.name: Sparse-LUT exact-stride alias control
mechanisms.source_basis: Package physical-GPU CUDA non-power-of-two stride-skew runs
mechanisms.source_motif: Power-of-two pitch bracketed by one 32-byte region
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: Exact 512- and 1,024-byte sparse pitches create native texture-path throughput aliasing that is removed by a plus or minus 32-byte skew below the general address-span transition.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 TLD/LDG matched pitch-skew matrix with mixed filler and per-load validation.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured address-index alias evidence without physical set bank or partition claims

mechanisms.name: VMM-isolated virtual address reach
mechanisms.source_motif: One 2 MiB physical allocation repeatedly mapped across 64-510 MiB virtual spans
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: The sparse-LUT 248-256 MiB transition persists when physical allocation and accessed physical payload remain fixed at 2 MiB; virtual address distribution and reach are therefore causal timing terms for the named workload.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 paired LDG/TLD lookup over repeated CUDA VMM aliases with fixed physical backing.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured virtual-address effect without hardware-page TLB page-walk set or partition claims

mechanisms.name: Content-sensitive CUDA VMM compression
mechanisms.source_basis: Package physical-GPU CUDA VMM compression probe and packed6 runs
mechanisms.source_motif: Explicit generic-compressible allocation tested with zero periodic and entropy-dense 6-bit streams
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: The driver grants generic compression and can expand all-zero throughput-equivalent allocation capacity through 240 MiB, but periodic and entropy-dense packed6 LUTs gain no effective cache capacity; compression benefit is content-specific and remains bounded by virtual reach.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 paired LDG/TLD packed6 decoding over effective mode-0 and mode-1 VMM handles.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured property and logical-throughput bounds without physical compression ratio cache-byte or DRAM counters

mechanisms.name: Constant-pattern CUDA VMM compression
mechanisms.source_basis: Package physical-GPU CUDA all-one VMM compression runs
mechanisms.source_motif: Every packed6 code is 63 and every packed word is 0xFFFFFFFF
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: An independently validated nonzero constant table reproduces the all-zero global compression boundary through 240 MiB, supporting a constant-pattern class while rejecting extrapolation to information-bearing LUTs.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 paired LDG packed6 decoding over effective mode-0 and mode-1 VMM handles.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Measured nonzero semantic control with logical-throughput and unavailable-counter bounds

mechanisms.name: Zero-sentinel texture validation guard
mechanisms.source_basis: Package physical-GPU texture alignment and constant mismatch controls
mechanisms.source_motif: Zero-valued expected output can mask an invalid texture return
mechanisms.normalized_technical_definition: A zero-only checker is insufficient for texture or compression capacity evidence; the fast zero-texture curve is rejected because an all-one sentinel produces zero valid timed payloads while information-bearing texture controls remain valid.
mechanisms.gpu_native_realization: Native sm_120 TLD versus LDG semantic controls with mismatch totals and exact table-group perturbation.
mechanisms.physical_hardware_realization: Named RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU through CUDA 12.8.
mechanisms.validation_state: Validated negative control and explicit correction of a prior zero-sentinel false positive
